about: Producer: analysis/roman_dchi2/v9/spline_budget.py (spline_budget.json). The error band on the spline basis: every coefficient p_i wrong at once, independently, with an rms sigma_i proportional to its one-node tolerance and scaled (lam) until the rms shift of Omega_m or S8 is 0.3 sigma; the error delta(k) = sum p_i B_i(k) then has rms b68(k) = sqrt(sum sigma_i^2 B_i(k)^2) (fraction), its 68% band; the 95% band is 1.96 b68. Same at every z; rigid fit; Roman xi_+- with example1_cov.
models_about: P^model/P^truth - 1 of NLA and TATT fitted to the truth at the fiducial cosmology without a cut (IA parameters only; v8/fid_fits.py), mean and range over the snapshots 0.2 <= z <= 2, on k_models (the 61 tents)
